settings.help.prompts: Set the default generation style; it can be overridden before generating.
settings.help.dictionary: Choose a definition source for word and phrase lookups.
settings.help.translation: When a dictionary has no result, translate the selection using the current AI or a self-hosted service.
settings.help.autoLookup: Open a lookup after text is selected. AI translation still requires confirmation.
settings.help.recommendation: Control online paper recommendations. Disabling stops new recommendations without deleting saved papers.
settings.help.recommendationStyle: Balanced combines recent and foundational work; Frontier focuses on recent research; Foundations considers topic relevance and accumulated citations; Cross-domain explores related topics. Changing this setting refreshes recommendations and saves the choice on this device. Citation counts are a reference, not a measure of paper quality.
settings.help.localLiterature: Connect directly to your literature API without signing in to Liteasy. Use cached data offline; profile data stays on this device.
settings.help.context: Context budget in tokens per request. Keep it within the model context window. Read document text on demand and reserve room for output.
settings.help.responseLanguage: Set the response language for future generations. Existing responses remain unchanged.
settings.help.interfaceFont: Choose the application font. This does not install system fonts or modify papers.
settings.help.readingFont: Set the default font for paper reading mode, e-books, and Markdown/TXT. Choose a system font or enter an installed font name; individual documents may override it.
settings.help.languageFonts: Choose separate Chinese and English fonts, from system fonts or by entering a name.
settings.help.emptyPanels: Collapse a panel when its last page closes or moves away. Disable to keep empty panels.
settings.help.markdownMode: Live preview combines reading and editing in the same text. Manual mode keeps separate edit, save, and read steps.
settings.help.autosave: In live preview, save existing files after typing stops. Pause on external changes or save failures while preserving the draft.
settings.help.density: Adjust list spacing and secondary information without changing document text.
settings.help.theme: Choose light, dark, or the system theme. Changes apply immediately and are saved locally; PDF reading backgrounds remain unchanged.
settings.help.fontSize: Adjust application text size without modifying PDF files.
settings.help.scale: Scale the application interface, panels, and controls. Use Ctrl + Plus or Minus to adjust and Ctrl + 0 to reset to 100%. PDF files are not modified.
settings.help.pdfBackground: Adjust PDF display colors with dark, soft-color, or custom backgrounds, without modifying the original PDF.
